$comment: Locale pages still serving an English <title>. Frozen so the backlog is enumerable and cannot grow; closing it is a translation job, not a code change. A page that gets a translated title must be removed from this list — the gate fails on a stale entry, so the set can only shrink. Now empty: the last 12 (six locale home pages, five topic hubs and the Yoruba topics index) were closed by translating them.
